context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements streaming output using ctx.createStream(), proper stream options, write/end lifecycle, and a trigger script that subscribes to the stream channel in addition to the task channel.

checklist.name: Default async handler
checklist.description: Uses export default async function handler with correct typed signature

checklist.name: createStream with options
checklist.description: Calls ctx.createStream() with bundleSizeBytes and/or maxLatencyMs options for low-latency streaming

checklist.name: Stream write calls
checklist.description: Calls stream.write() for each chunk/word of the output

checklist.name: Stream end call
checklist.description: Calls await stream.end() to finalize the stream

checklist.name: Guard ctx existence
checklist.description: Checks that ctx exists before calling createStream (e.g., if (ctx) { ... })

checklist.name: Final artifact return
checklist.description: Returns the complete text as artifact with mimeType after streaming completes

checklist.name: reportStatus at milestones
checklist.description: Uses ctx.reportStatus() to report streaming start and completion

checklist.name: Stream channel in trigger
checklist.description: Trigger script subscribes to stream.{agentName}.{taskId} channel for real-time chunks

checklist.name: Task channel in trigger
checklist.description: Trigger script also subscribes to u.{ownerId}.{taskId} for terminal events
